description: Onboarding IS the first coltrane pipeline. When a user clones coltrane-oss and claude reads CLAUDE.md, it dispatches this standard. The pipeline runs ON the user's freshly-cloned workspace: scans the repo, infers what lanes the work wants, judges which seeds to plant, instantiates Steves, and surfaces a verdict-shaped orientation report. The user experiences coltrane by watching it work on them. Every subsequent pipeline takes this same 5-phase shape — onboard-v0 is self-demonstrating.

conductor_mode.description: On first-clone, claude reads CLAUDE.md, detects no prior session record for this repo, and dispatches onboard-v0 via gig_dispatch with input={cwd, user_cwd_history}. The 5 phases walk in order; each phase's typed output feeds the next. Final orientation-report is surfaced to the user.

execution_modes.score_is_the_same: The standard JSON IS the score regardless of mode.

apoha: NOT a fleet-wide seeding sweep (that's seed-from-local-repos-v0) — onboard-v0 reads ONE repo (the cwd) and seeds Steves for THIS workspace only.
NOT a code-aware deep read — scan-level only. repo-scan captures shape, not mechanism.
NOT auto-resume — orientation-report SUGGESTS the resume command; the user chooses whether to wake any Steve.
NOT idempotent at the surface level — re-running onboard-v0 will spawn NEW Steves. Re-running is allowed but each run is a discrete seal-cycle (the audit-stream remembers).
NOT a replacement for the user reading CLAUDE.md — orientation-report is a nudge, not a summary of the genome.
